## 2026-11-21 — Import defaults and reported Source-map failures

Root applied and read back eight functional targets (six existing files plus two new tests) and three current documentation files after qualification. The working source now contains1086 functional/driver files; the other1078 original paths retained exact bytes, size, nanosecond mtime and identity. Publication base is e0879c7df74bc3704902bfdaf4ff74eee40c3aea. Current normal imports start both Physics and Hair & clothes off while retaining imported setup. Explicit On, existing body/hair/combined peer intent and explicit Record remain available.

Actual hidden Windows qualification:54/54 import assertions with all five MMD/GMod/SFM/VRM1.0/VRM0.x profiles; authored packed HAS/drawing/preview-export agreement; actual48-frame1920×1080,24fps,H264 movie lasting2seconds. Two cold-comparison failures are retained. The second run measured one JSON double differing by3.38813178902e-21 and three integral metadata values reopening as floats with zero numeric change. The test now captures expected full-precision JSON before Save, follows the established adjacent-double oracle with stricter boolean/integral handling, and additionally requires exact engine Vector3/Quaternion pose reconstruction. All unrelated assertions remain. A strengthened synthetic case and the pure --cold-oracle-only selector passed20/20 separately; the54-assertion runtime body is byte-identical to the qualified GPU source. No product persistence code was changed to disguise a failure.

Both owner-reported maps converted through the ordinary preparation path with the proposed BSP-only optional-light policy. gm_construct retained314 raw mesh summaries/310 serialized GLB meshes and64 of137 light declarations; ttt_tiny_spaceship_v3 retained252/234 and18 of105. Exact omission categories/raw entities were retained, the global64 limit remained, and strict generic light planning still refuses malformed input. This proves conversion and accounting, not native editor/visual acceptance, complete mounted-resource fidelity, every Source shader or photometry.

The qualifying private jobs closed; admitted originals/runtime/source inputs and the parent environment were preserved. The baseline360 complete Windows Full (170 groups/1084 files/4004.5350933s) remains historical evidence. No complete Full rerun for the new1086 source is claimed. Other scoped results remain distinct:123 headless candidate controls,24 easing math plus26 contact math controls, and25 CPU-only Junko bundle planner tests. These do not qualify actual all49-hair behavior, GUI interaction, body/skin contact or artist feedback.

Formal requirement IDs/statuses are unchanged: implementation52/54 (96.3%) and acceptance55/62 (88.7%), with seven human/device/external conditions still open. No human observation is substituted with automation.
